0. 0.1 FOREWORD

This Indian Standard .( Part V ) (.Third Revision ) was aclopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 25 October 1<82, after tE.e draft finalized by the Metl-od of Measurement of Works of Civil Engineering ( Each&&g River Valley Projects ) Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Engineering Divisicn Council.

0.2 Measurement occupies a very important place in the planning and execution of any civil engineering work from the time of first estimates to the final completion and settlement of payments for a project. Methods followed for measurement aie not uniform and considerable differences exist between practices followed by different construction agencies and also between various central and state government departWhile it is recognized that each system of measuren ent ha: to ments. be specifically related to administrative and fir ant ial organizations within a department responsible for the WOIk, a unification of various systems at technical level has been accfptec as \cry de&able, specially as it permits a wider range of operation for Civil engineering contraclors and eliminates ambiguities and misunderstandings of various systems followed. 0.3 Among various civil engineering items, measurement of buildings was th+ first to be taken up for stanc'ardization and this stanc'ard having provisions relating to building work was first published in 1958 and revised in lS64. 0.4 Since various trades are not related to one another, the Sect:onal Committee decided. that eat h type of trade as given in IS : 1200-l! 64* be. issued separately as different parts, which will be helpful 10 specific us,ers in various trac'es. This part covering formwolk was first isoued in 1972 and now revised so as to keep requirements up to date.

6.1 Formwork shall be measured in square metres as the actual surfaces in contact with the concrete or any other material requring formwork. Formwork to small features, such as in 5.1 (p) shall be enumerated. Formwork left in shall be so described. 6.2 Where formwork is required to be lined with wallboard, hardboard, polyethylene sheet or paper lining or to.be coated with mould liquid or limewhite, such formwo:k shall be so described and measured separately. 6.3 Where lining of wallboard, asbestos, cork slab and the like is of a permanent character ani is to be left in, such lining shall be measured separately; the description shall include any necessary fixing to the concrete. 7

IS : 1200 ( Part V ) - 1982 6.4 No deductions shall be made for openings up to 0.4 m2. Ko deduction shall be made for any opening/cutouts when slip form technique ii used. 6.5 Raking or circular cutting and rounded or n-oulded edges shall be measured in running metres. Moulded StOFpingS shall be enumerated. 6.6 Formwork to secondary beams shall be measured up to the sides of main beams, but no deduction shall be n-ade from theformwork of the main beam where the secondary beam intersects it. For m work to beam shall be measured up to sides of c olumn, but no deduction shall be made from the formwork to stanchion or column casings at intersections of beam.
